The most powerful compact Android gaming tablet has finally arrived. Meet the REDMAGIC Astra 2: a 9-inch gaming powerhouse built around the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, complete with a 185Hz OLED display, advanced AquaCore Cooling 2.0, and an 8,300mAh battery. This thing is basically a gaming PC that fits in your backpack.
Want to win a REDMAGIC Astra 2? Enter the REDMAGIC Global Giveaway from August 1–15, 2026. Three lucky winners will each receive a REDMAGIC Astra 2 Gaming Tablet!
What's the first game you'd play on the REDMAGIC Astra 2? Let me know in the comments!
